css_componentes.blockquote: .post-content blockquote { border-left: 5px solid var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); padding: 1rem 1.5rem; position: relative; margin: 1.5rem 0; background-color: rgba(143,188,143,0.06); border-radius: 0 0.5rem 0.5rem 0; } .post-content blockquote::before { content: '\201C'; font-size: 6rem; font-family: Georgia, serif; color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); opacity: 0.15; position: absolute; top: -1rem; left: 0.5rem; line-height: 1; pointer-events: none; }
css_componentes.comment_block: .nat-comment-block { position: relative; padding-left: 70px; border-left: 4px solid var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; padding-top: 0.5rem; } .nat-comment-block .nat-avatar { position: absolute; left: -55px; top: 0; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; }

label_cloud.css: .nat-label-cloud { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .nat-label-cloud .nat-label-item { padding: 0.35em 0.75em; border-radius: 50rem; background-color: #f0f0f0; color: var(--nat-text, #333); font-size: 0.85rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .nat-label-cloud .nat-label-item:hover { background-color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); color: var(--sl-text-main); }

label_lista_icone.css: .nat-label-lista li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0.4rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0; } .nat-label-lista li a::before { font-family: 'Bootstrap Icons'; content: '\F288'; margin-right: 0.5rem; color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); }

css_componentes.sidebar_widget_card: .nat-sidebar-card { background-color: var(--sl-card-bg); box-shadow: 0 0.125rem 0.25rem rgba(0,0,0,0.075); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

scrollbar.css: ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f1f1f1; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); border-radius: 4px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #6aaa6a; }

animacao_404.css: @keyframes float404 { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-20px); } } .nat-404-element { animation: float404 3s ease-in-out infinite; font-size: 5rem; color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); }

ad_placeholder_300x250.css: .nat-ad-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; max-width: 300px; height: 250px; background-color: var(--nat-bg, #f8f9fa); border: 2px dashed #ced4da; border-radius: 0.5rem; color: #adb5bd; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .nat-ad-wrapper:hover { border-color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); background-color: var(--sl-card-bg); box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1rem rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

reading_time_badge.css: .reading-time-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.25em 0.6em; background-color: var(--nat-primary, #8FBC8F); color: var(--sl-text-main); border-radius: 50rem; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; }
